Whether you made a profit or a loss during the financial year, reporting your stock market activity is necessary to stay compliant with the Income Tax Department. To help you calculate capital gains, turnover, and applicable deductions without manual calculations, Zerodha provides structured, tax-ready reports.
Important ITR Filing Deadlines (FY 2025-26):
• 31st July 2026: Non-audit individual returns (ITR-1, ITR-2)
• 31st August 2026: Non-audit business/profession returns (ITR-3, ITR-4)
• 31st October 2026: Accounts requiring a Tax Audit
